# fastclaude

> Small completions-style Python interface backed by the Claude CLI

## Modules

- [fastclaude.core](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/fastclaude/core.html.md): `astream` and `ClaudeRun`: stateless completions through the installed Claude Code
- [fastclaude.protocol](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/fastclaude/protocol.html.md): Handle Claude Code's stream-json protocol, including NDJSON transport, control requests, and deferred tool results
- [fastclaude.session](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/fastclaude/session.html.md): Read, write, and build native Claude Code session transcripts
